name: github
description: Gives an agent GitHub's own tools, plus git and gh, on the repositories you choose. Installs the hachiflow GitHub App instead of asking for a personal access token. Not an official GitHub integration. Maintained by hachiflow, not by GitHub.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Install hachiflow's GitHub App on GitHub and choose which repositories the agent may use. The agent gets a token that works for an hour at a time and only on those repositories.
